eps.t: My Next Interview's at the Demon Queen's Palace!
eps.ov: Rarely does a hero apply for a job with the Demon Queen. He has the skills, but he’s the one who defeated her army. Maybe he can clarify matters during his interview?
eps.ta: مقابلتي القادمة في قصر ملكة الشياطين!
eps.oa: من النادر أن يتقدم بطل لوظيفة عند ملكة الشياطين. لديه المهارات، لكنه هو من هزم جيشها. فلعله يوضح الأمور في مقابلة العمل؟

eps.t: Strive to Ease the Burden on Your Future Self!
eps.ov: Shutina is a model employee, but she’s overworked, overwhelmed and stressed out. If he can stop irritating her for five minutes, Leo can help her delegate and avoid burnout.
eps.ta: اجتهد لتخفف العبء عن نفسك في المستقبل!
eps.oa: «شوتينا» موظفة مثالية، لكنها مثقلة بالعمل مرهقة متوترة. وإن كفّ «ليو» عن إزعاجها خمس دقائق، قدر على أن يعينها في توزيع المهام وتجنب الاحتراق.

eps.t: A Little Bit of Thought Goes A Long Way for Efficiency!
eps.ov: Whose idea was it to put Lily in charge of logistics? Why are her proposals drawn up in crayon!? It’s up to Leo to give her a training and development course on teamwork.
eps.ta: قليل من التفكير يزيد الكفاءة كثيراً!
eps.oa: من صاحب فكرة أن تتولى «ليلي» الإمداد؟ ولماذا ترسم مقترحاتها بأقلام التلوين الشمعية!؟ صار على «ليو» أن يعطيها دورة في التدريب والتطوير على العمل الجماعي.

eps.ov: There are certain rules one must follow when the boss invites an employee out for food and drinks. Especially when said employee is concealing his true identity.
eps.oa: حين يدعو الرئيس موظفه إلى الطعام والشراب فثمة قواعد لا بد أن تُتبع، ولا سيما إن كان ذلك الموظف يخفي حقيقته.

eps.t: If You Want to Quit, Talk It Out First
eps.ov: There’s nothing wrong with quitting a job if it’s not a good fit. But one must make sure that it’s the best move for them and not something they’ll eventually regret.
eps.oa: لا عيب في ترك عمل لا يناسبك، لكن على المرء أن يتأكد أنها الخطوة الأفضل له، لا أمراً سيندم عليه في النهاية.

eps.t: The Hero Shares His Tale of Burden
eps.ov: Listening is a vital part of communication, and Mernes is perceptive enough to know that Leo is holding something back. So the former hero confides his secret to the assassin.
eps.oa: الإصغاء ركن أساسي في التواصل، و«ميرنيس» من الفطنة بحيث تدرك أن «ليو» يخفي شيئاً. فيفضي البطل السابق بسره إلى القاتلة.

eps.t: A Good Warrior Isn't Always A Good Boss
eps.ov: Edvard is a good warrior, but that doesn’t mean he’s a good leader. Especially when he thinks his troops aren’t trying hard enough when they fail at tasks he can accomplish.
People are more than their jobs. Long ago, an unexpected friendship set Leo on the path he walks to this day.
Time is running out for demonkind. Leo may have a solution, but that means revealing his identity to Echidna.

eps.t: I'll Save the World, Even If That Means Destroying It
eps.ov: The only ones who can save the world from the hero are the Demon Queen and her four generals!
Leo is a grave threat to the world, and no one understands that better than the former hero himself.
In the end, what does it mean to be a hero?
